title: Syrian Chicken Curry
description: A soothing and flavorful curry dish from Syria, made with chicken and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil to the skillet.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Return the chicken to the skillet and cook until the chicken is cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream, if using. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
